visual_text: Five good guidelines, 12 medicines, one person
ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE: AN IMAGINED 79-YEAR-OLD WOMAN WITH FIVE CONDITIONS
12 medicines plus a complicated non-drug regimen, if every guideline were followed
UK review: 133 potentially serious interactions between drugs in the NICE type 2 diabetes guideline and drugs for 11 other conditions. Potential interactions, not harm seen in patients.
Review the whole plan against what the person most wants (judgement)
Boyd et al., JAMA 2005; Dumbreck et al., BMJ 2015; Hughes et al., Age Ageing 2013
alt_text: Diagram: five single-condition guidelines (COPD, type 2 diabetes, osteoporosis, high blood pressure, osteoarthritis) feed one plan for an imagined 79-year-old woman, shown with 12 medicine bottles. A UK review found 133 potentially serious interactions with the NICE diabetes guideline drugs. Judgement: review the whole plan.
